en: Re-edited by the Southern Chan Śramaṇa Shouyi,
a member of the lineage of various masters of the religious precepts.
*The Secret Instructions on the Lineage of Linji*.
Nanyue Huairang, Daoyi, Haiyun, Xuanyun, Jiangrong, Zhaobuzhu, Nianzhao, Yuanhui, Duanduan, Yanqin, Falong, Huihua, Huijie, Yuxianfan,
Jujing, Qimiao, Benchang, Weiwei, Chichian, Shitai, Shilun, Jian, Dudu, Junwu, Chengci, Xuanxuan, Shuirui, Congbao, Chuanjing, Jinxiu, Xiaokong, Chongguang, and others.
Jingshan and Huqiu divided the ancestral lineages;
Dahui transmitted [the Dharma] to Xu, reaching Yongming.
Yi, Ci, Xian, Mi, Er, Yang, Qin, Youbao, Tie-niu, Yuan, Chi, Zhen, Huiji, Lai, Tong, Yan, Jiao, and Ming.
From the Sixth Patriarch, the Dharma was transmitted to Nanyue Huairang. Nanyue transmitted it to Mazu Daoyi; Mazu transmitted it to Baizhang Huaihai;
Baizhang transmitted it to Huangbo Xiyun; and Huangbo Xiyun transmitted it to Chan Master Linji Yixuan. Later generations established this as the Linji School.
It is unknown who composed these sixteen characters for the Linji Shìpài:
"Upholding the adamantine essence, shaking forth the wondrous return to the source; preserving compassion and aspiring to the precepts, they penetrate antiquity and soar through the present."
Continuing the performance:
The ancestral lineage is vast and great; the Buddha-dharma is broad and expansive. With a mind of rectitude, one grasps the fundamental texts and realizes the excellent cause.
By guarding the mind, one manifests the patriarchs; only then does one come to feel reverence and honor.
Later, fifty-six characters were added:
The teachings point toward the profound; Their ultimate aim is the Truth. In secret they accord with the eternal spirit;
through transmission, there are those who attain it. Successors replace one another in upholding and cultivating it; They maintain their resolve as a great light.
Qihong Zongda, Yongxing Shi Ji, Yuyong Yanzhao Shoucong Jingshi, Yueke Jiu Hua,
Xue Ruowei Bai Moji Kongyan, Ti Jiawu Duo.
It is unknown who composed these sixteen characters for the Linji lineage:
"The ancestral Way of Shan Hong is excellent; virtue alone may be preserved, perpetuating the light of Mingjue and glorifying the ancestral school."
The twenty-character lineage verse of Chan Master Huanglong Huinan of the eighth generation under Linji:
Hui Zheng Pu Jue Ji | Yuan Tong Zan Hai Qing | Guang Yan Fa Jie Xing Yong Yuan De Hong Zong.
The thirty-two characters for the lineage transmission of Chan Master Dahui Zonggao of Mount Jing, the twelfth generation under Linji:

Zong (宗) Jue (覺) Miao (妙) Dao (道) Ming (明) Liao (了) Ben (本) Zhen (眞) Hui (恢) Hong (弘) Zu (祖) Yin (印) Lian (聯) Guang (廣) Hui (慧) Deng (燈) Xing (性) Kong (空) Fa (法) Jie (界) Shao (紹) Ji (繼) Xu (續) Rong (榮)
The fruit of perfect penetration is fulfilled; the wheel of merit turns.
These sixteen characters of the lineage were transmitted by Chan Master Duanqiao Miaolun, the seventeenth generation descendant of Linji:
"Wondrous awakening of the nature of wisdom, the true mechanism fully revealed, universally saving and penetrating the source."
Fu Yinzhengguo, the nineteenth-generation descendant of Linji, Master Xingjin of Bifeng, expounded the twenty-character lineage verse:
Nature is empty, yet originally radiant; Mirror-wisdom is fundamentally void and profound; It is able to encompass all that exists.
Thus, the thirty-character lineage of Master Yunyan Fu’ai, the twenty-first generation under Linji who governed the Great Trichiliocosm,
is as follows: Fúdé hóngcí guǎng (福德宏慈廣) Póxuán jué dào chéng (普賢覺道成) Lìyì wúbiān jiè (利益無邊界)
The fundamental school flourishes eternally; wondrous awakening is ever full. Self-nature realizes perfect fusion.

The twenty-character lineage verse of Chan Master Zu Ding of Xuefeng in Minzhong, the twenty-second generation under Linji (the fifteenth generation under Tiantai): Zongben yǒng xīng lóng Miàowù héng cháng mǎn Zìxìng zhèng yuánróng (Aligned with the twenty-second generation under Linji and the fifteenth under Tiantai.)

The Patriarchal Way takes precepts and concentration as its essence; Fangguang is the true and perfect penetration. His practice transcends the realization of the limit of reality, and he fully comprehends and awakens to true emptiness.
This is the lineage of the Dharma transmission from Chan Master Yunmen Huanyou (Miyun and Tianyin), and also from Chan Master Yuanwu Xiu.

The present-day descendants of this lineage (Tiantong Qingshan) and all subsequent worthies have uniformly used the upper lineage for the transmission of the Dharma; this follows the intention of Longchi.
Longchi further continued the sequence by appending twenty characters beginning with "Xu" (續) and "Kong" (空).
The nature of awakening is fundamentally and eternally quiescent; the mind is identical with the dharma-realm. As it accords with conditions, the sublime teachings of the holy ones flourish forever.
(The twenty characters following the "empty" [空] character in the original are continued here by the Celestial Youth.)
Successing the lineage of Cao’an, he transmitted the merit of saving all beings; the lamp of wisdom constantly illuminates the world, and the Buddha-Dharma spans the heavens.
This is the twenty-eighth generation of the lineage of Linji, recorded by Chan Master Miaosui of Qingshan.
The characters read:
Miao succeeded in the grand transmission of the True Dharma Eye; Xing followed from the mirror-like awakening, while Qing ensured prosperity.
Che, Ke, Yin, and Zong perfected the Buddha-fruit; They upheld the ancestral Way, continuing the succession of fragrance.
The one hundred and twelve characters for the lineage transmission of Chan Master Dongming Haizhou Yongci of the twenty-fifth generation under Linji:
Puyong Zhiguang Hongshengde Jinghui Yuanming Zhengfaxing
The ocean of nature is clear and still, manifesting the secret seal; The wondrous path of the Mahāyāna is the lamp for awakening the mind.
The Buddha’s grace is vast and full, its fragrance flowing far; The patriarchal practice transcends the school, its succession profound.
Precepts and concentration grow ever firmer as one masters the principles; The established rules are reverently observed, remaining eternally new.
Wing the good to bring prosperity and flourish, thereby attaining the fundamental source; Auspicious signs abound and increase, further propagating merit and virtue.
Quiescent illumination merges with the true realm; The precious mirror hangs high, its essence and function intimately joined.
Beneficial spiritual texts unfold in brilliant beauty; Faithfully upholding these profound records is a treasure for saving the age.
"Clearly realizing the boundless emptiness of all illusions; the Bodhi tree blossoms and its fruit naturally perfumes.
Currently, the various lineages under Chan Master Zhuan’an Tongwen have all changed this from the character "kōng" (empty) to the character "qīng" (pure).
This school begins with the character "qīng."
The Sixteen-Character Lineage of Chan Master Tukung Zhiban (25th generation under Linji, 7th generation under Bifeng):
Wisdom is pure; virtue and wisdom are perfectly luminous; the ocean of the nature of True Suchness.
Quiescent Illumination Universally Pervades Wutai, Emei, and Putuo; the Former Temple continues the evolution of the thirty-two characters:
The Source of Mind Widely Continues; Original Enlightenment Flourishes; The Holy Fruit of the Benevolent One.
Constantly manifesting magnanimity, transmitting only the Dharma-seal, realizing enlightenment through harmonious integration,
and steadfastly upholding precepts and meditative concentration— these are forever recorded as the legacy of the ancestors.
At Putuo Rear Temple, the lineage from the "Tong" character under the "Tu-kong" branch continues to evolve through the forty-eight characters.
The profound Dharma-realm is vast, expansive, and majestic; It fills the entirety of original enlightenment, the heart of the realized teaching.
Only the spirit is lucid and all-pervading; Its essence and function are perfectly complete.
Through hearing, contemplation, and cultivation, Calm abiding and insight are ever harmonized, As the wondrous principle is transmitted and upheld.
Successing the ancient worthy masters, through faith, understanding, practice, and realization, the moon brightens in the midst of heaven.
This is the forty-character lineage verse of Chan Master Wutai Yueshan Zhisheng of the twenty-fifth generation under Linji (the seventh generation under Bifeng).
Wisdom fundamentally understands the nature of mind; Only through awakening one's thoughts can one become a sage.

The True Dharma increases the path to Buddhahood, and the vast teachings can be transmitted. As the moon reflects upon the waters of a thousand rivers, Its light extends across the sky of ten thousand li.
If one lacks pure wisdom, With what heart could one pay homage to the Thousand Hands?
The forty-character lineage verse of Chan Master Daisui Zhichao of Western Shu (the seventh generation under Bifeng, twenty-fifth generation under Linji):
Wisdom pervades the vast dharma-realm; Thoroughly realizing the Way, one attains the fruit of realization; The sacred teachings remain ever full and complete.
The ocean of awakening is perfect and luminous;

(Continued) the bright pearl illuminates the world. The seal of the mind is originally without inscription; Its subtle operation penetrates the celestial eye, Proclaiming it throughout all time, from antiquity to the present.
The Forty-Character Lineage Verse of Chan Master Zhisu (Jizhu) of Xufeng on Mount Lu, Twenty-Fifth Generation under Linji (Seventh Generation under Bifeng):
Wisdom is perfect, bright, and supreme; Precepts, concentration, and awakening are pure meditation; Sublime conduct penetrates all directions and expanses.
The Heart School’s Eternal Transmission (Twenty Characters Continued by Later Generations): Maintaining the Formless Dharma, A single stroke precedes the opportune moment;
The moon in the eternal void radiates its light, inherently natural.
The Twenty-fifth Generation under Linji (the Seventh Generation under Bifeng): Chan Master Zhiguang of Tianchi on Mount Lu;
Yanpai, Zhijiang, Yuanming, Hongci, Wuben, and Daode (the eleven characters above do not form a coherent sentence and are thus retained as they appear, followed by the subsequent verse).
The Right Dharma flourishes and the Esoteric Source continues; Sustained by celestial grace, may we forever uphold the Middle Precepts.
Through the practice of pure contemplation, one realizes the emptiness of the mind through hearing, reflection, and study.
This is the sixteenth generation of the lineage descending from Linji, beginning with Chan Master Xueqiao Yuanxin (1666–1732), the thirtieth successor in the line of Linji.
Master Yuanhong Duanjiao: He transmits the ancestral mind-seal and is a celestial pivot of the Dharmas of precept, concentration, and wisdom,
a master of spiritual transformation.
The twenty-four character lineage of Master Yǎn of Gētóu on the Western Hills of Beijing, under the thirty-seventh generation of the Linjì school (the third generation under Tūkōng).
The Text on Pure Virtue is Completed. The Buddha-Dharma, the Wisdom of the Benevolent One, is by its very nature perfectly luminous; its practice and principle are universally penetrating.
This was continued by a successor in the stage beyond training. (Twenty-four characters).
Having mastered the wondrous meaning of the Tripiṭaka and investigated the ultimate truth that the "half-character" has no inherent essence or function,
one whose power of concentration is thus able to transcend the mundane and realize the sacred.
(The later generations of Jiangyou also continued twenty-four characters starting from below the character "xué" [to learn]).
The Great Master of True Awakening, Hongzong Guangjing, who Universally Flourished Right Enlightenment;
the High Sage of Eternal Blessings, Ocean of Fortune, who Transmitted the Mind; the Patriarch of Certainty, Wenzhang Shouxin.
Under the Linji Lineage, the thirty-first generation (the nineteenth under Jingxi); the Chan Master Longxiao, styled Wenxue of Shengyin, continues this exposition.
Twenty-eight characters:
Longji can propagate the profound essence of the Dharma; Firmly upholding precepts and meditative concentration, he ensures its eternal transmission.
With a spiritual mechanism that is clear and penetrating, he illuminates this purpose; His nature of wisdom is ever-perfect—the Chan of Buddhas and Patriarchs.
The thirty-first generation under Linji, Chan Master Nanyue Shanzai Tongji, derived the twenty-character lineage from the character "Tong" (通):
Tongda benlai fa (通達本來法) | Hongkai zudao long (宏開祖道隆) | Huideng hengyong zhao (慧燈恆永照)
Having realized the infinite,
National Preceptor Yulin Tongxiu, the thirty-first generation descendant in the Linji lineage, while residing at Mount Tianmu,
further expounded twenty-four characters.

The Dharma widely saves the patriarchs; the True Doctrine continues on. May it be perpetually transmitted to the eminent and talented, with pure and luminous Brahma-conduct. Strictly maintained throughout antiquity—this is the posthumous name of Chan Master Tongwen Ruohan of Lianhua Monastery in Hangzhou, the thirty-first generation under Linji, whose courtesy name was Congyuan. His root of virtue is sublime. His wise counsel is vast. His lineage extends back through the ages. His conduct is eternally pure. His teachings are profound and enduring. His influence reaches far and wide. His legacy shall never fade. His spirit remains ever-present. His wisdom is boundless. His compassion is infinite. Through his power, all beings are brought to liberation. Through his grace, the world attains peace. May this inscription serve as a testament to his great merit. May it inspire future generations to follow his example. May the Dharma flourish forever. May the Sangha prosper eternally. Thus ends the record. Recorded by [Name]. Carved by [Name]. Inscribed by [Name]. Year [Year], Month [Month], Day [Day]. May it be auspicious. May all beings attain enlightenment. May all realms be transformed. May all obstacles be cleared away. May all blessings be bestowed. May all suffering be ended. May all joy be attained. May all be in harmony. May all be at ease. May the sun and moon shine forever. May the mountains and rivers endure. He arose and expounded sixteen characters:
"The Great Dharma of Perfect Penetration / Instantly Transcends the True and Constant / Awakening to the Patriarch, Surpassing the Master’s Wisdom,
the Lamp of Enlightenment Shines Forever."
The thirty-first generation descendant of the Linji lineage, Chan Master Muchen Daomin of Pingyang in Shaoxing, composed another twenty-eight characters:
"The Way is originally the Buddha-nature of all ancestors; Its clarity is like the bright sun shining in the midst of heaven."
The spiritual source is vast and moistening; the breeze of compassion is far-reaching. A true lamp illuminating the world hangs suspended for ten thousand ages.
This was composed in forty characters by Chan Master Poshan Haiming of Shuanggui in Sichuan, the thirty-first generation descendant of Linji.
The Sea-Seal emits light; awakening to truth brings eternal prosperity. The nature and mind are quiescent and constant, perfumed by precepts, concentration, and wisdom.
The Buddha-body attains its fruition; the ancestral Way joins in fragrance as two cassias flourish in the wilds.
Crossing the river on a single reed, one’s contemplation of Chan remains steadfast and far-reaching.

The thirty-two characters for the lineage transmission of Chan Master Mugun Tongmun (1685–1754) of Gunam Monastery in Jiaxing, the thirty-first generation under Linji, whose five reckonings were far-reaching: (1) 一、一法界心，萬法之本； (2) 二、二諦圓融，理事無礙； (3) 三、三身具足，報化隨機； (4) 四、四儀常寂，動靜一如； (5) 五、五蘊皆空，色心不二。 (1) 六、六根清淨，塵勞即道； (2) 七、七覺支分，迷悟同源； (3) 八、八正導引，邪正不立； (4) 九、九品蓮臺，階級頓超； (5) 十、十方普現，法界周遍。 (1) 十一、十一面觀音，悲智雙運； (2) 十二、十二因緣，生滅無性； (3) 十三、十三祖傳燈，心印相續； (4) 十四、十四忍辱行，煩惱即菩提； (5) 十五、十五種光明，破諸黑暗。 (1) 十六、十六大願，度盡眾生； (2) 十七、十七地功德，圓滿成就； (3) 十八、十八空理，離諸執著； (4) 十九、十九尊聖眾，護持正法； (5) 二十、二十重華嚴，事事無礙。 (1) 二十一、二十一箇祖師，各證自心； (2) 二十二、二十二種隨形好，相好莊嚴； (3) 二十三、二十三箇法門，隨機演說； (4) 二十四、二十四孝子，忠孝兩全； (5) 二十五、二十五有苦海，一念超越。 (1) 二十六、二十六部經論，教理行果； (2) 二十七、二十七賢聖，同歸一道； (3) 二十八、二十八天宮，因果昭然； (4) 二十九、二十九種修行，斷惑證真； (5) 三十、三十位菩薩，階位圓成。 (1) 三十一、三十一世臨濟宗，燈燈續焰； (2) 三十二、三十二相八十好，佛身圓滿。
Tongshun, Zhuanhua; Bo, Shen, Zhuwen; Shensu, Yingyan—expounding the profound and deep;
Xingzhi, Fuyuan; Zhiming, Daoxing—the treasury of the True Dharma Eye, forever carried on the lamp of transmission.
The thirty-two characters for the lineage transmission of Chan Master Han Yue Fazang of Sanfeng, Changshu, the thirty-first generation under Linji:
Fa (Dharma) Hong (Great) Ji (Aid) Shang (Supreme) De (Virtue) Zhong (Weighty) Lüyi (Vinaya) Jiao (Teaching) Kuò (Expand) Dunyuan (Sudden Perfection)
Practicing honored compassion and patience, one must realize the truth through diligent study.
Nurturing harmony with the practice, one subsequently attains the profound abyss;
this lineage shall be perpetually transmitted as the thirty-second generation under Linji (the second generation under Pingyang). This is the dharma-lineage evolution by Zen Master Tienyue Benzhou.
Thirty-six characters:
Fundamentally constant, Used with serenity and diligence, The moon is empty and white, The mirror is void and bright.
Detached wisdom and discernment, Pervasive and mindless, Return to the Great Sovereign— This is the single seal of the Dharma.
Bing Dangji; Six Can Be Verified; This Lamp is Transmitted.
These sixteen characters for the lineage transmission were expounded by Chan Master Hongchu Jiqu of Lingyan Mountain, the thirty-second generation under Linji (the second generation under Sanfeng).
Fahong cultivated wisdom; Daohang’s practice transcended his lineage. They successively upheld the true and eternal succession.
Taoyao and Zonglin were the thirty-second generation under Linji (the second generation under Sanfeng). [Name obscured] Shoji Hongsheng Chan Master expounds this lineage.
Sixteen Characters:
The Great, Profound, and Esoteric Seal; Manifesting the True and Orthodox Constant; Strategically Arranged to Re-Revive, Preciously Maintained for Eternal Prosperity.
Under the thirty-second generation of the Linji lineage, Chan Master Wugai Xingche of Tiantong began his teaching with the character "Xing" (行) and expanded it into sixteen characters;
this branch was widely propagated in the region north of Chu at the Wan’ian Zong Qingliang Temple.
Practitioner of Great Origin and Far-Reaching Legacy; One Who Transformed and Guided the Worthy and Spiritually Gifted; Grand Proponent of the Lineage of Precepts, Concentration, and Wisdom;
Direct Descendant of the Lamp of Linji, the Thirty-Second Generation (Dharma Heir of Poshan Ming); Chan Master Xiangyai Xingting of Huangbo, Fuzhou.
Another performance of sixteen characters:
The nature-path flourishes; wisdom is perfectly penetrating; auspicious light shines everywhere, and virtue revives the ancestral tradition.
The forty-character lineage chart of Great Master Hanshan Deqing of the Linji school, starting from the character "De" (德),
representing the sixth generation after Tufeng.
Virtue is great and merit is vast; Compassion and forbearance are universal in measure.
Cultivation transcends the Dharma-realm, And realization merges with the wondrous mind. Quiescent, pure, and awakened, ever full;
The essence of perfect luminosity is pervasive, Its light of wisdom constantly shining bright, As the Way’s transformation flourishes for long.
The Chan Master Lingyin Hutang Jiyuan (of the third generation under Sanfeng), the thirty-third generation under Linji,
further expounded sixty-four characters.
The True Sect realizes its essence, directly pointing to the source of the mind. Tracing it back against the current is exceedingly distant;
vast and ancient, it endures forever. It unifies the end by returning to the origin, abiding in the center while manifesting at the periphery.
Revolving with the course of destiny, its spiritual mechanism is unfathomable.
The Exoteric and Esoteric teachings are perpetually transmitted; those of sharp intelligence attain immediate understanding. Having grasped the essential meaning, they explain and interpret it;
their lofty banner of vows is firm, and their heavy armor of patience is steadfast. Emulating the aspirations of the predecessors, you should be prudent and diligent.
The Fifty-Six Character Genealogy of Chan Master Weian of Pumen Temple on Mount Huangshan, Anhui, under the lineage of Linji (the thirty-second generation from Dushun).
Only the Awakened Benevolent One’s vows and practices are vast; within the wondrously luminous, quiescent, true, and eternal, he is a pure and clear source, an ocean of precepts and concentration.
Auspicious goodness flourishes forever as the fountainhead of the Dharma-ocean;
merit and wisdom share the same root, extending far to provide universal relief. His constant mind shines eternally, and his innate virtue is magnificent.
Awakening to the fruit and diligently cultivating the ancestral legacy; with wisdom and power, universally realizing the Way and attaining perfect penetration.
This is the sixteen-character lineage transmission of the Linji school, from the seventeenth generation at Pilu Monastery.
The nature of sudden enlightenment is fused; the principle accords with the True School. The orthodox lineage of Vulture Peak flows on far and wide and prospers.
This is the thirty-third generation under Linji (the ninth generation under Tukung), the lineage transmitted by the Great Master Zibo Zhike of Guizong.
From the character *zhen* (True) begins sixteen characters:
The True Dharma is primordially present; The Seal of Liberation is eternally numinous; The Lion’s Great Roar from the Gate of Compassion is like the sound of thunder.
Chan Master Dingru Shijue of Fucing Temple in Xiangshui, the thirty-fifth generation under Linji, continuing the lineage from the character "Kong" (空) with forty characters:
The transformation of Kaiyuan in Jiande spreads the transmission of the mind, shaking the Great Unity; the lamp of wisdom shines forth in vast illumination.
The Dharma lineage flourishes forever; the ocean of wisdom merges with the pearl-tree.
A vast torrent of the Way’s stream issues forth, as the spiritual mechanism inherits the awakened nature.
For generations, the lofty and sublime has been succeeded—under the Linji lineage, the thirty-sixth generation (the sixth under Baoen)—Miaoyun Chongru Chan Master of Changchun Temple in the Capital.
The Master expounded these twenty-four characters:
Revere the Buddha and follow the Patriarchs; Virtuous conduct is perfectly harmonious. Clearly maintain the pure precepts to realize the fundamental school;
The source of the mind continues perpetually, And the Way of the Dharma flourishes and prospers.
Appended below this are twenty-four characters for the new lineage:
The Wisdom-Awakening of the Muni, The Root of Prajñā eternally flourishing, The Fruit of realization ever perfected—
Transmitting solely the School of Nature, Capable of inheriting the Patriarchs’ seal, Shining brilliantly as a universal lamp.
The Sixtieth Generation of the Lineage of the Sixth Patriarch, as transmitted by National Teacher Huilin (Fóyuán), Abbot of Yàowáng Pǔjì Temple,
under the Thirty-Seventh Generation of the Linji Lineage (Chóng Rùfǎ Sì).
The Buddha-principle is great faith and compassion; universally saving all, it is equal from the very beginning. The Dharma is expounded and pure precepts are maintained;
the mind awakens and true dhyāna manifests. The ocean of wisdom is clear and limpid; the joy of insight shines broadly to the ends of the world.
Radiant and identical to the Way of the Benevolent One (Śākyamuni), the sages and worthies reveal spontaneity; the profound emptiness accomplishes wondrous meaning.
Dense and solemn, transmitted for eternity; Blessings and affinities ever flourishing and elegant. Flower fragrance leads to the perfection of fruit.
The fifty-six characters of the lineage of Master Daokai of Taiping Temple in Jixi, Anhui—thirty-seventh generation under Linji (seventh generation under Ba’en)—further elaborating the branch.
The national custom of the Western Land points toward actual power; To clarify the mind and perceive its nature is to transcend the worthy ones at once.
When the fruit of Bodhi is fulfilled within the Flower Treasury Realm, The True Thusness of the Noble Truths hangs suspended through ancient and modern times.
Diligently cultivate the precepts and penetrate the wondrous principle; The radiant light of wisdom shines brightly, manifesting throughout the heavens.
With spiritual acumen fully awakened, he grasped the intent of the "Holding Up of the Flower"; possessing the karmic affinity to continue the fragrant flow of the True Dharma,
Chan Master Jingan Liaogen of Juehai Monastery in Jiaxing, Zhejiang— the thirty-seventh generation under Linji (the seventh generation under Baoen)—
received the transmission from the lineage of Former Master Kong, expanding it by twenty characters (the first line employing the ancestral lineage of Longchi).

The nature of awakening is fundamentally and eternally quiescent; the principle of the Benevolent One is naturally realized through the mind-to-mind transmission of the wondrous truth. His enduring virtue is most sublime.
At Tiantai Huading Monastery, forty characters were also continued from below the character "Kong" (空).

The essence is tranquil illumination and unconditioned; principle and phenomena are fundamentally inclusive. Tranquil and upright, it gives rise to wondrous function, as the scales reveal the Sage’s merit.
The Three Vehicles are divided into sudden and gradual; the intent of Chan and the Teachings is the same.
He established the principles of Mount Huaping, leaving a legacy that brings glory to future generations.

The thirty-eighth generation under Linji (the eighth generation under Baoen): Chan Master Bailing Dazhen of Guoqing Temple on Mount Tiantai, beginning from the character "Da" (達), recited forty characters.

Attaining the Way and penetrating the measure of truth, Clarifying the capacity and surpassing the ancestors; Right awakening transcends wondrous learning, and the light of great function is perfected.
The pure sound of the stone chime is revealed; In the ocean of nature, the source of salvation continues.
Upholding the Buddha’s mind-seal, the Dharma-realm is widely proclaimed.
Chan Master Dingzong Zhenguo of Baiyi Temple in Hangzhou, the fortieth generation under Linji, further composed these fifty-six characters:
The sun shines clearly ten thousand miles across the heavens; Mountains, rivers, the great earth, and all of space.
The eternal pulse of the school’s tradition has its source and root here;
Now that Anhe has inherited and continued the lamp, I look only to the virtuous descendants of the Benevolent One (Śākyamuni) To make the Way loftier than the ancient ancestral temple.
May such restoration be accomplished anew, So that all the foundations laid by successive generations may flourish like lotuses.

The twenty-four characters separately expounded by Chan Master Yunkaitianxia of Nanzhan Temple at Haichang (the ninth generation under Foyan; the fortieth generation under Linji): [The twenty-four characters follow here] (Note: As the specific twenty-four characters were not provided in the source text, the structure above indicates where they would appear.)
Heaven, by virtue of his illustrious virtue, established the Way and revitalized the fundamental principles;
upright and centered, he ensured the long continuity of the world’s order. Partaking in the same realization as pure wisdom, his fruition was perfected and auspicious signs attended him.
Chan Master Kongheng of Jiufeng at Xianlin Temple in Hangzhou, the forty-first generation under Linji, [attained] the state of Emptiness.
Below the characters, the twenty-character lineage is further expounded:
The Dharma is good, the mind is universally transmitted; Wisdom awakens, illuminating the void and its manifestations; Contemplation is sagacious, sincerity brings far-reaching vision;
The nature is pure, accumulating functional power.
The thirty-third generation under Linji (the ninth generation under E’ou), Chan Master Ruomei Zhiming of Kaixian on Mount Lu,
expounded these sixteen characters.
The Buddha-dharma flourishes; where there is an opening, there must first be a precursor. To perpetuate the lineage for ten thousand years, we transmit the lamp to succeed the patriarchs.
The various branches descending from Linji, whose number of generations is currently unknown, are here appended provisionally and await further investigation.
Chan Master Zhuan Yu Guanheng of Zilin Monastery in Jinling initiated a lineage of thirty-two characters beginning with the character "Guan" (觀).
Guan Yin Xuan Ming (觀音旋明) Wen Fu Qing Jing (聞復清淨) Shu Sheng Miao De (殊勝妙德)
True and Perfect Penetration, Merit surpassing that of precepts and meditative concentration,
Practice transcending the single wisdom of clarity; Vast in vows, complete in merit and wisdom—
Thus are the twenty-eight characters for Chan Master Wunian Shenyu of Huangbo Mountain, who established a school at Macheng.

The Patriarch’s awakening is the essence of pure conduct; He constantly harbors the ocean of true suchness, where precepts, concentration, wisdom, and supernatural powers are perfectly luminous. May prosperity flourish forever and peace be seen.
(Continued: A single moon in the empty sky reflects upon a thousand rivers; Shining upon the world with spreading light, the transforming sun grows ever long.
Having recognized the face of the person of original nature, the ancestral wind naturally expands for ten thousand ages.

Chan Master Huilang of Baoci (whose place of residence is unknown) personally composed these sixteen characters: Recognize the face of the person of original nature; The ancestral wind naturally expands for ten thousand ages.
The source of salvation is vast and boundless; the awakened nature is clear and perfect. Like the Sea Seal reflecting light, it receives all rivers as they flow toward the ocean.
Wuxuan Xingcong Chan Master (whose dwelling place is unknown) spontaneously composed these forty-eight characters.
His innate wisdom was wondrously awakened, and the true mechanism was fully revealed. He extensively penetrated the source of salvation, harmonizing cause with fruit;
he transmitted the Buddha’s mind-seal and directly expounded the supreme vehicle, propagating the great holy Way.
His learning surpassed that of those in precepts and meditative concentration, and his influence arose from Mount Song.
The Patriarchal Lamp shines universally, its brilliance illuminating both the present and the past.
This was personally composed by Chan Master Jieya Juexiu (whose dwelling place is unknown) as a thirty-two-character exposition on the Sudden Teaching.
Awakened wisdom shines forth alone, and spiritual fortune flourishes thereby. The moon of precepts is made manifest, and the light of the mind penetrates through to its depths.
Compassionate conditions respond fully, and the fruits of vows spread their fragrance ever more widely.
May the lineage of salvation be perpetually exalted, and the true pulse of the Dharma remain deep and long.
The Lineage and Essential Instructions of the Guiyang School:
Baizhang and Guishan Daoyou; Yangshan Huiji and Xuefeng Yicun; Nanquan Puyuan and Linji Yixuan; Bai Zhao Huaiqing and Changsha Jingcen—five generations are contained therein.
From the Sixth Patriarch, the lineage was transmitted to Baizhang Huaihai; Baizhang transmitted it to Muzhou Daowu (Shanwu); and Muzhou transmitted it to Yangshan Huiji.
Later generations subsequently established the Weiyang School. The school’s lineage evolved through a twenty-character verse (it is unknown from which generation this originated).
Zongfu’s Dharma-virtue and wisdom were profound; his Samantabhadra-practices and vows were deep. Wenshu’s vast and great wisdom brought about the realization of Equal and Right Enlightenment.
Ming of Yangshan was the sixth generation under the Sixth Patriarch; Guifeng was the tenth collateral descendant under the Sixth Patriarch.
It is not yet known why this lineage is similar to the later Gui-feng lineage.
Under the fourth generation of Miu-shan, Chan Master Ba-zhao Hui-qing and his disciple Ji-che Chan Master jointly expounded twenty characters.
Huiji, Miaozhen, Heng; With a mind empty, they awakened to the Supreme Vehicle. Continuing the lineage and propagating the Dharma far and wide, their linked lamps shine for ten thousand ages.
The Genealogy of the Dongshan Lineage (Twenty-eight Generations).
Qingyuan Si, Xiangyan Yan, Daowen Cheng, and Guishan Jia;
Ying, Bei, Zhi, Guan, Xuanqing, Ju, Kai (Jue, Bian, Bin, Ti, Man, Xiu, Chun, Liao, Jue, Jian, Jing, etc.);
Yuyu, Taiyu, Caiyan, Gaibin, Congzai—these scribes transmitted the teachings of Shaoshi. The transmission of Jia reached twenty-four volumes.
From the Sixth Patriarch, the Dharma was transmitted to Qingyuan Xingsi. Qingyuan transmitted it to Shitou Xiqian. Shitou transmitted it to Yaoshan Weiyan.
Yaoshan transmitted it to Yunyan Tansheng. Yunyan transmitted it to Dongshan Liangjie. Dongshan transmitted it to Master [Yunju Daoying and Caoshan Benji].
Later generations established these as the [Dongshan-Caodong] School.
The twenty-character lineage verse of Chan Master Wansong Xingxiu of Jingtu Monastery in Shunde Prefecture, the fourteenth generation of Dongshan:
Xing cong fu zhi li (行從福智立) | Guàn tōng ba huan zhong (貫徹八環中) | Hua tong san qian jie (化統三千界) |
The Chan Master Xueting Fuyu of the Shaolin Patriarchal Monastery, a fifteenth-generation successor of the Dongshan lineage (the dharma heir of Wansong Xia),
extensively propagated the Dongshan school and composed a seventy-character genealogical verse beginning with the character "Fú" (福).
The Son of Wisdom, endowed with merit and insight, awakens to the realization that the fundamental is originally perfect and can be understood.
His Way is vast, expansive, and universal; his excellence is shared with the Mysterious Ancestor. The ocean of pure *tathatā* is profoundly still, tranquil, and unadulterated.
His virtuous influence spreads and his talent extends eternally; his wondrous essence is ever firm and solid. His mind shines brightly, illuminating the profound depths.
Innate nature is luminous and discerning, exalting the sovereign mandate; Within, rectitude brings forth goodness and auspiciousness. With solemn sincerity, may he deliver us;
may Xueting be our guide, Leading us onto the path of returning to the Origin.
The thirteenth generation under Dongshan (the fourteenth generation under Caoshan); A descendant of Yuzhang in Jiangxi, continuing the lineage for twenty-eight generations.

His name is Qingjing Juehai (Ocean of Pure Awakening), whose realization is perfect, vast, and expansive; He awakens to the fundamental, true, and eternal nature of wisdom, which is broad and spacious;
The ancestral Way flourishes as he transmits the Dharma-eye, Universally pervading the sands of the world while his mind remains settled in samādhi.

The Twenty-Character Lineage Verse of Chan Master Zhihong (the fourth generation under Wansong Xinyue, the sixteenth generation under Dongshan): Zhi xin ding de bao, Zhi shan liao dao xing, Miao jing ben ming zhen.
Wisdom, faith, concentration, attaining the treasure; Vow, goodness, realization, the practice of the Way; Sublime purity, original luminosity, the truth.
The True Dharma is to be contemplated with utmost care;

this is the thirty-two-character lineage chant of Venerable Master Jingxian, the nineteenth generation under Dongshan (the sixth generation under Wansong). □ Dao Gong. Respectfully. Chan Master Yanpai.
32 Characters.
Homage to the one who has perfected their practice and attained auspicious blessings;
who continues the lineage of the Mind-Lamp and realizes the nature of universal penetration; who universally delivers the great trichiliocosm;
and who, as the authority of the Cao-Dong school, transmits the seeking according to the bowl and upholds the ancestral command of Wansong.
The Twenty-Character Lineage of the Yongpae School of Heunghwa-sa on Bonggyeok-san in Sundeok-bu (the sixth generation under Seoptyeong),
the twentieth generation under Dongshan: Ryo-in Myeong-jo-do, Gyeok-hae Yong-hong-seon, Po-do Da-jeon-gye.
The lineage of Chan Master Haikuan of Shaoshan (the seventh generation of Queshan; the twenty-sixth generation of Dongshan), who ascended the same Prajñā boat,
consists of one hundred and twenty characters derived from the school of his master Juezi, beginning with the character "Yan."
The ocean of awakening is eternally vast; the transmission of the lineage is proclaimed and bestowed.
The authentic pulse extends afar, while auspicious blessings flourish. Self-nature is all-pervasive;
the fundamental, perfect, and unobstructed principle of true wisdom is pure, limpid, and clear—a true reality of tranquil illumination.

Compassionately pitying and benefiting sentient beings, universally delivering them with impartiality; Through skillful means and provisional measures, he inaugurates the teachings for the wise and sagely;
Virtuous conduct achieves merit, and study leads through awakening to the realization of the Dharma;
The Dharma rests upon faith and capability, honoring the practice of śamatha-vipaśyanā and samādhi-prajñā through hearing, reflection, and cultivation.
Adorning the stages of practice, darkly harmonizing with the *Santong* (Great Agreement), Virtue is full and fruition is perfected as the Buddha continues the lamp of the lineage;
Upholding the seal of the mind (*cittamudrā*), serving as a model for the world— Such is my vow:
may the world follow this teaching, Taking the "Other Shore" (*pāra*) as its patriarch.
Bequeathing instructions to descendants: may the lineage succeed its predecessors and flourish hereafter, prospering eternally for ten thousand generations.

Under the twenty-sixth generation (eleventh generation under Zhìhóng) at Dòngshān, the Chan Master Jiàndìng Miàoxiàng of Yànjīng Gēnmùshān resided at Qīngjìng Ān and ordained the Chan Master Tiānhuá Jìng□ as the twenty-seventh generation (beginning with the character "Jìng").
The Twenty-Character Verse of the Yan Lineage:
Jingshan Xiangran, Xijing Zong; Wanguang Rui, Baoyue Xianmingdeng;
Shijie Haoyue, Xuanyuanzhao; Tongtian Liao, Dao Guan Qiankun.
The twenty-sixth generation under Dongshan (the twelfth generation under Xueting), Chan Master Xuzhao Hongji of Tianning Monastery in Shunde,
was the teacher of Liu Bingzhong, the Grand Guardian of the Yuan Dynasty; he separately evolved a sixteen-character lineage which is popularly known as the "Liu Taobao Lineage."
Master Wuming Huicheng of Shouchang, Jiangxi (26th generation of the Dongshan lineage [12th generation of Xueting])—May his friends be vast and numerous;
may blessings and virtuous causes bring auspicious celebration; may concentration and wisdom be perfectly luminous, eternally honoring the enlightened nature.
The Twenty-Character Verse of the Yan School:
Wisdom perfect, the Way great, prosperity and compassion; Awakening the source, transmitting the lamp to continue the ancestral nature;
The ocean of nature clearly illuminated, manifesting the Dharma-realm; Extensively propagating vows and practices, realizing the true and eternal.
From Shouchang, the lineage branched out to Boshan Wuyi Yuanlai Chan Master, who further developed twenty characters to form the (Dai Yi Yuan Lai) school.
Yuan Dao Hong transmitted them as follows:
One Mind’s Radiance Universally Shines Through, The Patriarchs’ Dharma Eye Flourishes.

The lineage of the Shouchang school under Dongshan has reached the twenty-seventh generation (the thirteenth generation under Xueting). Chan Master Yuan Cheng (Sanmu Zhanran), [abbot of] Xiaosheng Temple in Shaoxing,
composed another verse of fifty-six characters.
When the conscious mind reaches its fundamental source, the Great Way is revealed. The Benevolent One unfolds it extensively; the ancient wellspring is deep and long.
Cause and effect are harmoniously penetrated; both Exoteric and Esoteric teachings are equally exalted.
The Clouds of Dharma moisten all equally; the sacred tree spreads its fragrance; the lamp of wisdom shines with brilliance.
The Universal Radiance of Compassion, responding through transformation and riding upon the vehicle of destiny, sealed the profound primordial framework to support successive generations;
his transmission spread far and wide through twenty-eight generations under Dongshan (fourteen generations under Xueting). Chan Master Shunde Kaiyuan Wan’an Guang... (Gong).
The surname Jia (賈) is further expanded into thirty-two characters,
colloquially known as the "Jia Bodhisattva Lineage" (賈菩薩宗): Guangcong Miaopu (廣從妙普), Hongsheng Xichang (洪勝禧昌),
Jizuxuzong Huizhen Weifang (繼祖續宗慧鎮維方), Yuanming Jingzhi (圓明淨智), Dexing Fuxiang (德行福祥).
Clarifying the Ocean of Enlightenment and Realizing the True and Constant:
Twenty-eight Characters for the Lineage by Chan Master Xingyang Qingpou Miaojing (the thirtieth generation under Dongshan [Wan’an], the third generation under Wan’an).
The wondrous, luminous ocean of enlightenment is perfect, vast, and expansive; Awakening to the fundamental, true, and eternal nature of wisdom is broad.
The ancestral Way flourishes as the Dharma-eye is transmitted; Universally pervading the sands of the world, the mind is settled in samādhi. (Note:
This lineage is identical to the later "Yuanzhang Yan" lineage of the Caoxi school. The reason for its preservation here remains unknown and awaits further investigation.)

*Zhuan deng zhengzong* (Transmitting the Lamp of the True Lineage) *Yongshao Xin feng* (Perpetually Successing Xin Feng) *Rentian yifan mianyuan changlong* (A Model for Humans and Devas,

The Eye of the Dharma flourishes and is transmitted; its mystery pervades the entire realm of sand-grains.
The mind is harmonized, luminous and pure; the fruit of practice arises spontaneously. The Tathāgata’s intent was like the plucking of a flower;
his merit is vast, immense, and far-reaching. He emits light to certify the stage of awakening; firm, wondrous, eternal, and perfect. The udumbara flower manifests once again.
Zhi and Guan were revered for their sudden realization; Yan and Hong transmitted the imperial seal. Their benefit remains forever boundless;
their spiritual mechanism is solely vast and penetrating. The moon shines brightly in the midst of heaven; Da Tong perfected the sacred learning.
Successors have occasionally provided verbal explanations; the nine cauldrons of hearing and contemplation continue. Thus I employ this to repay the single lamp of Chan.
The bright sun shines from the midst of the sky; ten thousand streams all return to their source.
At Longzang Temple in Yuqian, Chan Master Huicheng Xiangjue of the thirty-fourth generation under Dongshan (the eighth generation under Zhanran) expounded these twenty characters.

Auspicious light shines universally and perfectly; Original enlightenment flourishes and prospers. The Dharma is propagated, continuing the Buddha’s lamp to eternally transmit the Zhenran (湛然) school.
Master Muye (牧雲), a Chan master of Yongning Temple on Lingji Mountain, continued this lineage by adding these sixteen characters.
Pure wisdom is wondrously perfect; the ocean of merit is serene and clear. Widely propagating the ancestral lamp throughout the Dharma realm, may it remain ever distant and bright.
Under Dongshan, the thirty-seventh generation (under Xuzhao, the twelfth generation). Chan Master Wujie Mingxin, beginning with the character "Xing" (Nature).
Continuing the performance of Liu Taibao’s sixteen characters:
His nature is expansive and far-reaching; His wondrous function is boundless. He embodies the emptiness of the ultimate reality;
The ancestral Way is honored and flourishing.
Chan Master Hongjue Xingdao of Taiyue Temple in Shangyu, Shaoxing, Zhejiang—the thirty-eighth generation descendant of Dongshan—composed these twenty-eight characters himself:
Hongjue Daoshi manifests the Way for himself as his school; Before Mount Taiyue, the ancient wind vibrates anew.
A universal aspiration for descendants throughout the Dharma-realm: Wu-xing Yue-shun, who is fully and perfectly realized;

the forty-fourth generation below Dong-shan (Yuan-lai is the eighteenth generation below); Chan Master De-feng Shou-cun of Lian-hua Temple in Tong-ling County, continuing the evolution of the Twenty Characters of the Great Ant Lineage.
The lamp of Shouchang illuminates the world; the True Dharma shall flourish forever. The seeds of virtue are like precious lotuses, and their transformative influence fills the heavens.
